derivation:
by
  refine (List.perm_append_comm_assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  simpa only [List.append_nil, List.append_assoc] using List.perm_append_comm_assoc (pBlock s t u ++ nBlock s t u) (mBlock s t u) []
explanation: Apply this core theorem twice: first swap nBlock and pBlock, then swap their combined block with mBlock using an empty third argument. Only append reassociation and empty-list simplification are needed.
